column1: # Cards we own that no singles order accounts for.
# Order history only knows about singles and about the sealed box itself, so
# without this a theme deck's 18 Fire Energy look like zero. scrape_quantities.py
# adds these on top of the order-history counts.
# product      key from the table below
# sealed       yes = still shrink-wrapped, so the cards are owned but not playable
# qty          how many of that card are in one copy of the product
# url          TCGplayer path, blank until the card is added to product-ids.tsv
# card         what it is, so a blank url is still readable
# charizard-td  2020 Vivid Voltage Charizard Theme Deck, opened, Fox plays it
# mbg-starter   MEGA Starter Set Mega Gengar ex, Japanese, UNOPENED
# other         loose cards whose origin was never written down, counted by hand
# Both decklists verified against Bulbapedia wikitext and both total exactly 60.
